description: Kalmunai Municipal Council - Kalmunai Municipal Councils Proposal Budget Report - 2023
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns a local government budget proposal for public inspection at the Kalmunai Municipal Council. It is an administrative matter related to municipal governance and public finance procedures, which does not fit into any of the government-related classifications (Types 1-3) or the specialized categories (Types 4-9). The content involves local government administration rather than central government structure/personnel, making it fall under the Miscellaneous category.
